Adjacent input for whoever grades and fixes this card (skills seat R1, recording so it does not live only in a closed card's report comment): the new `scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs` (PR #13944) has a live-sweep mode whose only scheduled caller candidate is the same `half-state-patrol.yml` this card is about. The delivering dev's recommendation, recorded on #13922: wire the clause-② live sweep into that patrol as a separate small change by whoever owns the workflow — **but only rendering its rows in their OWN section**, otherwise the new rows re-inherit exactly the flat-list trimming defect this card documents (231 findings, 74 rendered, 157 omitted). Sequencing: fix this card first, or wire with an own-section renderer in the same stroke.

本评论来自分诊座位(R+81 集中轮,裸卡 29/40)。⛔ 本座位不认领、不派发、不写码、不合并。

## 判据:机制两端都复验到源

- **裁剪点**:`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs:7789`
  ```js
  const notice = `\n- _… ${rows.length - i} further row(s) omitted to fit GitHub's issue-body limit; the full list is in the workflow run log._`;
  ```
- **被违反的不变量**,`.github/workflows/half-state-patrol.yml:73-75` 原话:
  > `silent non-delivery would leave a stale anchor body that reads exactly like a clean board — the #4690 failure ("could not read the input" must never look like "input is clean") with a timestamp on it.`

## ⭐ 缺陷的精确形状:**族内的帽子是有原则的,族外那把裁刀不是**

脚本里已经有一整排**逐族**上限:`BLOCKING_DEPENDENT_LIST_CAP`(:2368)、`H19_TARGET_LIST_CAP`(:3201/:4725/:4751)、`H20_BRANCH_LIST_CAP`(:3580)、`H36_SAMPLE_PATHS`(:6366)、`H37_MEMBER_LIST_CAP`(:6611)。每一处都是「这一族最多列几条」——**有语义的取舍**。

而 `:7789` 那把是**扁平列表上的位置裁剪**:一行能不能活下来,取决于它前面碰巧排了多少条不相干的行。

⇒ 一句话:**族内按重要性裁,族外按运气裁。** 这是卡该被修的那句判据,比「68% 丢失」更能指向修法。

而且 `:7099` 已有现成范式:「only as a COUNT, so 「199 further row(s) omitted」」—— 脚本自己就懂「列不下就给计数」,只是没把这招用到族这一层。

## ⚠️ 一处降级:标题「the anchor reads clean」说过头了,body 说得准

自测面里有三条专门钉「裁剪要自报」:`:13232`「markdown: the trim announces itself in the body」、`:13254`、`:13319`。⇒ 裁剪**不是静默的**,`157 further row(s) omitted` 就印在页上,而且是**被测试保护的既定行为**。

卡的 body 说得很准:*"the ones that did not appear at all cannot be told, from the page, apart from families that found nothing"* —— 真正丢的是**族的可辨性**,不是「有没有告诉你丢了东西」。标题把它压缩成「reads clean」,读起来像 #4690 的静默形态,那会误导定级。

⇒ 按 body 定级,不按标题。**这就是我给 p2 而不是 p1 的理由**:它不是「读不出却装作干净」,是「说了丢多少、没说丢的是谁」。H31 那个例子(0 行渲染,读者无法区分「板上没有分裂」与「分裂行在那 157 条里」)仍然完全成立,而且是本卡最有力的一条。

## 卡自己划的三条「不主张」全部保留

⛔ 不主张这是判据谓词的 bug(计算是对的,问题在投递)· ⛔ 不主张知道丢的是哪 157 行(run log 未取)· ⛔ 不主张修法。这三条我不动 —— 它们是这张卡的质量所在。

⚠️ 补一条给实施者:那条「full list is in the workflow run log」的出口,**日志有保留期、未与 body 互链、也不是分诊轮会去读的通道**。⇒ 任何把「去看日志」当作已解决的修法,都没有修。

## 邻卡与时序

本卡已有一条来自 skills 座位的相邻输入(2026-08-31T18:32Z):`scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs`(PR #13944)的 live-sweep 唯一候选调用方就是本卡所指的同一个 patrol,建议**要么先修本卡,要么接入时同笔给它自己的分节**,否则新行会原样继承这个扁平裁剪缺陷。⇒ 本卡与 #13922 / PR #13944 存在**时序关系但非阻塞**,不挂 `pm:blocked`;实施者接手时读那条评论。

## 路由

`pm:queue` · `priority:p2` · `domain:skills` · `tooling`

`domain:skills` 按最近同类校准:#13922(同为 `scripts/pm/` 的巡检工具卡)= `tooling` + `domain:skills` + p1。

## 查重

卡自己已做过一次查重并**在卡里写明了阳性对照**(24 条结果含已知控制词 #11217 / #12994,故非 #13326 形态的假零)—— 这是本轮见到的做得最规范的一处,记一笔。最近邻 #13573 / #13900 / #13373 均为**其他通道**的截断,⛔ 无一覆盖「巡检自己写短了 body」。复核同意,无重复。

## Refresh — the drop is **growing**, and here is a concrete row it swallowed today

Re-measured on the current anchor (#9857), swept `2026-08-31T19:44:16Z`, run `33431915270`:

| | this card (2026-08-31 18:24Z) | now | Δ |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| findings computed | 231 | **237** | +6 |
| rows rendered | 74 | **75** | +1 |
| rows omitted | 157 | **162** | **+5** |
| rendered share | 32.0% | **31.6%** | −0.4pt |

The anchor's own line, verbatim: `_… 162 further row(s) omitted to fit GitHub's issue-body limit; the full list is in the workflow run log._`

### A named casualty, found the expensive way

I audited the `Blocked-by:` reverse index by hand across all 40 open `pm:blocked` cards and found **#12343** — open, targeted by open `#12211`'s `Blocked-by:` line, and **not carrying `pm:blocking`**. That is textbook **H14** (`!carries && dependents.length > 0` at the predicate's own last branch — there is no exemption for its `pm:awaiting-maintainer` state, so the row is computed).

It does not appear in the anchor. ⇒ Its H14 row is one of the 162.

The cost is exactly what this card predicts: `pm:blocking` ranks **second in the lane selection order**, so a missing cache row means a real unblocker never outranks anything — and #12343 is a maintainer decision card that has been open **7 days** with a blocked dependent behind it.

### What the omission cost in seat time, measured on this session

⚠️ Worth recording because it is the failure mode, not a complaint: this seat re-derived by hand, over ~40 minutes and ~30 API reads, findings the patrol had **already computed 5 hours earlier**. Most pointedly **H28 on #11975** — *"BODY names 1 CLOSED `Blocked-by:` target (#11974) while a COMMENT names 1 that is still OPEN (#13515) … so the body line is STALE"* — which is precisely the repair this seat made today, believing it had found it. That row **did** render; I had simply not read the anchor first, which is the protocol's stated first duty. But the same seat cannot read what is not there, and #12343 is the case where reading it would still not have helped.

⇒ Two distinct failures compound: a seat that skips the anchor pays for rediscovery, and a seat that reads it still sees only 31.6%.

### Note on remedy shape

⛔ Not proposing one — grading is triage's. Recording only that the full list **does** exist in the workflow run log, so this is a rendering/routing problem rather than a detection one, and that the omitted share is drifting the wrong way while the computed count grows.

**CLAIM** — skills-lane PM seat, session `session_01Msg17tAHJ3jVTYFgHydCm2`, branch `claude/issue-13947-patrol-family-visibility`.

Scope: the anchor renderer in `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` (workflow file only if the renderer change strictly requires it). The lane's remedy ruling, taking triage's criterion (comment 5486911772) as the spec — "族内按重要性裁,族外按运气裁" is the defect, and the file's own `:7099` count-only pattern is the precedent:

1. **Every family becomes legible even when its rows are cut**: an unconditional per-family summary (family → computed / rendered counts) that renders regardless of the body budget, so an omitted family is distinguishable from an empty one — the H31 case (zero rendered rows indistinguishable from "no split on the board") is the acceptance test.
2. **The flat budget allocates by family severity, not arrival position**: gate-semantic families (H31-class) outrank inventory/hygiene families when rows are trimmed.
3. The omission notice keeps announcing itself (the existing self-test-protected behavior stays; grade-by-body per triage — this is a legibility fix, not a silent-truncation fix).

Sequencing input (comment 5482734531): the clause-② live-sweep wiring into this patrol is NOT this card — but the renderer must not preclude own-section rendering for it. Non-governed pure-code face ⇒ in-seat review then ready + auto-merge per lane rule. Tier: opus (scripts/pm/**, no path mandate; clause-②: no).

**ACCEPT** — seat review of record (skills-lane PM, session `session_01Msg17tAHJ3jVTYFgHydCm2`), verified against GitHub, not the report's self-description.

Deliverable: PR #14071 (+574/−6, `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` only — Assumption A held, no workflow edit). Verified first-hand in the diff:

- **Both mechanisms land and are correctly non-interchangeable**: the five-band registry + `familyRank` in the sort (inserted BELOW the loud and unjudged reservations — the #11218 ordering survives, pinned), and the unconditional per-family ledger RESERVED out of the body budget before the first row, in the same tradition as the trigger index and the reserved sections. The acceptance criterion holds textually: "computed 6 / rendered 0" and "computed 0" render as distinct, self-test-pinned shapes.
- **The reservation is a proved bound, not a guess**: probe-at-0 and probe-at-all plus digit slack, with a self-test driving every trim outcome against it (tight to ≤64 bytes); the declared 6,000-byte ceiling is BUILT (worst case measured at 3,754 B) and is an eighth of the render budget.
- **Registry honesty is mechanical**: `familyRegistryCoverage` scans this file's own source for pushed codes — fixtures assembled, not written literally, so the scan cannot be fooled by its own tests; a new family without a band fails the self-test.
- **The trim still announces itself** — the three protecting cases stay; grade-by-body honored. The dev's ablation also caught and fixed a vacuous assertion in its own new case (bare `indexOf` passing at −1) — recorded in place, the right reflex.
- **Live before/after on real board data**: 22 of 22 computed families now accountable (was 17, with a gate family — two H35 rows — fully invisible); every gate and stall family renders in full; the honest trade (fewer total rows fit) is stated in the PR, and the defect was never row count.

**Band-table adjudication (the open question): Option A — land as proposed.** Every placement traces to something legible (H31/H35 from their own headers; the inventory band from triage's named examples), the table is one greppable edit, and the ledger itself now makes any misplacement visible on the next sweep instead of silent. The two B candidates (H14 given the 7-day #12343 casualty; H8 as arguably stall) are exactly the kind of one-line follow-up the ledger's evidence should drive — if H14's computed/rendered pairs show repeated starvation on live sweeps, promote it then, with the reading attached. C (a per-family floor) stays out, as the dev correctly kept it.

**Landing path (non-governed pure code)**: CI at head `0e42227db` is 28 completed all green — including the real `Live half-state sweep` passing over this renderer — with Lint & Repo Gates and one Test Core shard still converging. Per the lane rule the seat flips ready + arms auto-merge once EVERY check is green; this comment is the at-tier PASS of record for that arm. The dev's out-of-scope finding (#14072, H22-vs-census contradiction driving 38% of the corpus) is triage's to grade.
